The wrapper reuses the existing memo and preserves the proof algorithm, which is the smallest sufficient approach to repeated work. It adds no persistent cache, invalidation protocol or speculative extension. Reuse would need reconsideration if proof inputs gained consumer-specific state outside the operation's fixed bindings or new mutable inputs not captured by its view.
